summary.result: Calibration results showed that the annual mean inflow were within ${\pm}5%$ error compared to the observed. $R^2$ were ranged 0.61~0.87, RMSE were 1.37~7.00 mm/day, NSE were 0.47~0.83, and RMAE were 0.25~0.73 mm/day for daily runoff, respectively.
summary.background: The expected future inflow to Namgang dam using RCP 4.5 is increasing by 4.8 % and RCP 8.5 is increasing by 19.0 %, respectively.
summary.method: The SWAT model was calibrated and validated using observed flow data from 2003 to 2014 for the study watershed.

summary_ko.background: RCP 4.5와 RCP 8.5를 이용하여 남강댐에 대한 예상 미래 유입량은 각각 4.8 %와 19.0 % 증가하였다.

summary_ko.result: 보정 결과는 연 평균 유입량이 관측값에 비해 ${\pm}5%$ 오차 내에 있으며, 일 평균 유출량에 대한 $R^2$는 0.61~0.87, RMSE는 1.37~7.00 mm/일, NSE는 0.47~0.83, RMAE는 0.25~0.73 mm/일 범위였다.
